3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: Leon Malenyev stepped on the carpet and started to make his way toward us.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: The door of the pitch black sedan opened and flashes went off.
4.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_CapitalistRayne"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_CapitalistRayne"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Arcasia"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Arcasia"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true) == false)

5.speaker: Lucian Galade
5.text: “Is the welcome to your liking, sir?”

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: The famous ideologue and CSP leader, Leon Malenyev, came out of the car, smiling and waving at the enormous crowd that gathered. It was not every day the Chairman of United Contana came to visit Sordland.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Both sides of the maroon carpet leading up to the palace were lined with soldiers wearing military uniforms from Sordish history. They had swords, shields and spears. Some of them were on horseback.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: He looked at the extraordinary interior design of the Maroon Palace. Statues, paintings and various ornaments filled both sides of the corridor.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: As soon as Leon Malenyev stepped on the carpet, children appeared and showered the road with roses. He approached the kids, knelt down and told them something which made them laugh for minutes.

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: We started walking towards the reception hall in the palace. Our path was cleared of people at once.

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: Lucian approached my side and quietly whispered.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: It was then that the centuries-old Sordish sword dance started. The show took around a minute at most, but Malenyev didn't even try to look like he was paying attention to it.

19.speaker: Leon Malenyev
19.text: "It was definitely very long. But it was fine. I tried to sleep most of the way."

22.speaker: Player
22.text: “I wanted extravagance, not a circus show. What the hell is this?”

25.speaker: Player
25.text: “As long as it does the trick, I don't care.”

26.speaker: Lucian Galade
26.text: “But... but I don't understand, sir. I did everything you asked.”

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: He looked at me with an expressionless face.

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: As soon as our inspection finished, we entered the palace.

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: As soon as Leon Malenyev stepped on the carpet, all of the soldiers performed a hard salute. Celebratory gunshots were fired. Trumpets started playing a Sordish march.

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: Monica and I walked over to meet him in the middle.

34.speaker: Leon Malenyev
34.text: "I don't think your army needs to put on such airs in the midst of a burgeoning global conflict. War is not show business."

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: Finally, I was within reach of one of the most powerful men in the world.

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: We looked at each other and shook hands.

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: He turned to Monica and shook her hand.

40.speaker: Player
40.text: "It is an honor to have you here."

41.speaker: Narrator
41.text: Monica and I walked over to meet him in the middle.

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: Finally, I was within reach of one of the most powerful men in the world.

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: We looked at each other and shook hands.

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: As soon as our inspection finished, we entered the palace.

46.speaker: Deivid Wisci
46.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_CapitalistRayne"] == true

47.speaker: Deivid Wisci
47.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_CapitalistRayne"] == true) == false

51.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Arcasia"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true

52.speaker: Deivid Wisci
52.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Embargo_Arcasia"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true) == false

57.speaker: Player
57.text: "Please, this way. Let's move to the palace."

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: On the way to the entrance we stopped in front of Iosef who was in charge of the troops.

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: A maroon carpet stretched from the vehicle to the palace, lined with Sordish troops. War planes flew above our heads, painting the sky with the colors of the Sordish flag.

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: Malenyev smiled and saluted Valken and the soldiers. They saluted back.

62.speaker: Player
62.text: “I've wanted to meet with you for the longest time.”

63.speaker: Player
63.text: “It is wonderful to see you, Chairman Malenyev.”

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: Seeing Malenyev approach, Lucian stood back.

65.speaker: Leon Malenyev
65.text: "Mrs. Rayne. A pleasure to meet you."

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: Finally, I was within reach of one of the most powerful men in the world.

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: Malenyev smiled at the soldiers and saluted them. They saluted back.

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: On the way to the entrance we stopped in front of General Valken who was in charge of the troops.

71.speaker: Player
71.text: “It is really good to see you, Chairman Malenyev.”

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: He turned to Monica and shook her hand.

74.speaker: Player
74.text: “I wanted to meet with you for the longest time.”

78.speaker: Leon Malenyev
78.text: "It is nice to meet you, Mrs. Rayne."

79.speaker: Narrator
79.text: As I was trying to formulate a response, he placed his hand on my shoulder and laughed.

83.speaker: Leon Malenyev
83.text: "What a welcome, Mr. Rayne. I didn't know Sordland was this connected to its feudal past."

84.speaker: Narrator
84.text: He turned to Monica and shook her hand.

85.speaker: Player
85.text: "It is an honor to have you here."

86.speaker: Player
86.text: "Please, this way. Let's move to the palace."

87.speaker: Player
87.text: “I've wanted to meet with you for the longest time.”

88.speaker: Leon Malenyev
88.text: "It is nice to meet you, Mrs. Rayne."

92.speaker: Leon Malenyev
92.text: "It was definitely very long. But it was fine. I tried to sleep most of the way."

94.speaker: Player
94.text: “It is wonderful to see you, Chairman Malenyev.”

95.speaker: Player
95.text: "Didn't you like the ceremony, Chairman Malenyev?"

96.speaker: Leon Malenyev
96.text: "I... am honored by the lengths to which you went, Mr. Rayne. Truly impressive."

97.speaker: Player
97.text: “Don't mind us. We were just passing by.”

99.speaker: Narrator
99.text: At that moment, we came to the end of the corridor and entered the reception hall.

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: He took a seat and I followed suit.

101.speaker: Narrator
101.text: Upon our entry, a crowd started clapping. It was composed of various politicians and state figures. Dry martinis were handed to both of us.

102.speaker: Player
102.text: “Ladies and gentlemen. I present to you, Leon Malenyev.”

103.speaker: Player
103.text: “Everyone. Let's give a warm welcome to our guest of honor.”

104.speaker: Narrator
104.text: We arrived at a cozy little corner office with not much inside other than a table and comfortable chairs.

106.speaker: Narrator
106.text: Gradually, the music and the sound of the party started to fade away.

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: With another thunderous round of applause, the Contanian band started playing.

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: He and I swapped our drinks for glasses of Erlory Maroon 30-Year-Old. I knew a special spot. With our drinks in hand, we went down the stairs to the basement.

109.speaker: Narrator
109.text: Malenyev and I started talking to the other guests. The reception was in full swing.

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: After some time chatting with the attendees, Malenyev turned to me.

111.speaker: Leon Malenyev
111.text: "Can we go someplace where we can hear each other better?"

112.speaker: Leon Malenyev
112.text: "It's very nice of you to throw a party for me before our official talks, but I am still slightly tired from the long journey over the ocean."

113.speaker: Leon Malenyev
113.text: "Forgive me if I didn't seem too enthusiastic about the reception. I just don't have the same energy of my youth."

114.speaker: Leon Malenyev
114.text: "Time is a funny concept, isn't it?"

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: He smiled and took a sip from his glass. Then he sighed.

116.speaker: Leon Malenyev
116.text: "You cannot feel it in the moment, only to realize later that your life passed you by. And one day you look in the mirror and see an old man."

117.speaker: Player
117.text: "You are right. It is a scary concept."

119.speaker: Player
119.text: "I believe you used your time relatively well so far, Chairman Malenyev. You had a very full life."

120.speaker: Player
120.text: "When I look at you, I don't see an old man."

121.speaker: Player_Italic
121.text: Take a sip from your glass.

122.speaker: Leon Malenyev
122.text: "I've seen many presidents and world leaders change during my lifetime. I've seen toppled governments, civil wars and war crimes. I fought against imperialism and the capitalist plutocracies that took its place."

124.speaker: Leon Malenyev
124.text: "I look at the world today and think, it has changed so much since I joined the Rotskis as a young revolutionary..."

125.speaker: Leon Malenyev
125.text: "But then I look at it again and realize nothing much has really changed."

127.speaker: Leon Malenyev
127.text: "What do you see? A hero of the proletariat? The red scourge?"

131.speaker: Player
131.text: "I see a respectable man. And the leader of the strongest nation in the world."

132.speaker: Player
132.text: "I'll pick 'old man' if those are my only options."

134.speaker: Leon Malenyev
134.text: "Pfft. Say it like it is, Mr. Rayne. I'm just an old man. There is no need for exaggeration. You can speak your mind freely."

135.speaker: Leon Malenyev
135.text: "You surprised me. It's usually one or the other, depending on who you're asking. But never together."

137.speaker: Leon Malenyev
137.text: "That's the right one. There is no need for needless exaggeration. We are all men. And I'm an old one at that."

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: He pointed at one of the statues in the corner as we walked. It was a white marble sculpted representation of Albrecht Renan, the founder of the Renan Aristocracy.

141.speaker: Leon Malenyev
141.text: "Was he the one? The original owner of the Maroon Palace?"

142.speaker: Player
142.text: "Yes. It was built as his summer residence."

143.speaker: Player
143.text: "As far as I know, he didn't use it much. It was Soll who transformed this place."

144.speaker: Player
144.text: "His name is Albrecht Renan, Chairman Malenyev. And yes, he was."

145.speaker: Leon Malenyev
145.text: "I thought when Tarquin Soll came to power, he worked towards removing the republic's connection to its feudal past."

146.speaker: Player
146.text: "I don't know. It's just a statue to me."

147.speaker: Leon Malenyev
147.text: "It is interesting that he removed the images of the last kings but not the older figures. Was he fond of the aristocracy, or the man?"

148.speaker: Leon Malenyev
148.text: "To me, all of this has meaning. It is always useful to know why certain historical images are displayed while others kept hidden."

149.speaker: Leon Malenyev
149.text: "You are not a man of history, then?"

150.speaker: Player
150.text: "As a matter of fact, I am. My field was history before I entered politics."

155.speaker: Player
155.text: "The future interests me more than the past."

156.speaker: Player
156.text: "As a matter of fact, I am quite interested in history. Maybe just not the statues."

157.speaker: Player
157.text: "I have no idea. You have to ask the man himself."

158.speaker: Player
158.text: "I believe he was fond of both. He cared a lot about our national values."

159.speaker: Player
159.text: "I know he despised the kingdom. But I think he still needed a glorious past to make people proud. That's where Renan came in."

160.speaker: Leon Malenyev
160.text: "How come you are uninterested in your own past, then? I'm not the one who put these statues here."

161.speaker: Leon Malenyev
161.text: "You cannot see what the future holds for you if you're not literate in history."

162.speaker: Leon Malenyev
162.text: "It is important to learn from the past. Or else we'll keep on making the same mistakes."

163.speaker: Leon Malenyev
163.text: "That's what I suspected. If it was not going to be the kingdom he despised so much, it made sense to look further back."

164.speaker: Leon Malenyev
164.text: "Well, I think he couldn't erase history just like that. He still needed a past that made him and his people proud. If it was not going to be the kingdom he despised so much, it made sense to look further back."

165.speaker: Leon Malenyev
165.text: "In the end, I'm just an old man."

166.speaker: Leon Malenyev
166.text: "He just left in the parts he liked. Isn't it fascinating how a single person can alter history just like that?"

167.speaker: Leon Malenyev
167.text: "It is perhaps even more divided than ever. There are still wars in every corner of the world. There is still poverty, violence and slavery."

168.speaker: Leon Malenyev
168.text: "Don't you think we need to step up as leaders of this world to try to put an end to this?"

169.speaker: Player
169.text: "I completely agree. We need proper international cooperation to tackle these problems."

170.speaker: Player
170.text: "I do. That's why I'm meeting with you. To change something."

171.speaker: Player
171.text: "I think United Contana isn't entirely innocent in these conflicts."

175.speaker: Leon Malenyev
175.text: "I don't play games like the Arcasians. I can tell it as it is."

176.speaker: Leon Malenyev
176.text: "Perhaps we cannot ever create our utopias. But that doesn't mean we shouldn't try."

178.speaker: Leon Malenyev
178.text: "And that's where the CSP comes in."

179.speaker: Leon Malenyev
179.text: "Yes. We were involved with a lot of conflicts that turned bloody. Was there any other way? I don't know. Probably not."

180.speaker: Leon Malenyev
180.text: "Today, the whole continent is at peace, Mr. Rayne. And now the rest of the world is furious."

182.speaker: Player
182.text: "In the end, you formed the largest country in the world."

186.speaker: Player
186.text: "There are many countries who look up to United Contana. You are not alone."

187.speaker: Player
187.text: "They are afraid of your power. Contana was never united before."

188.speaker: Leon Malenyev
188.text: "They are afraid of the power of the people, Mr. Rayne. They are afraid that the oppressed will one day unite. That was the power of our revolution in Contana."

189.speaker: Leon Malenyev
189.text: "That's exactly what our enemies are furious about."

190.speaker: Leon Malenyev
190.text: "They were. But the revolution lives on in Contana now. It's time we help others."

191.speaker: Leon Malenyev
191.text: "We have. And now our responsibility is great. We cannot sit back and let Arcasian imperialism enslave the third world."

192.speaker: Leon Malenyev
192.text: "I still remember how Contana was a massive war zone. When all the warring states were supplied weapons by the west. Kings and dictators killed each other."

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: He took another sip from his glass and stretched his hand to me.

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: I grabbed his arm and helped him stand up.

204.speaker: Leon Malenyev
204.text: "Can we talk somewhere a little less damp? I need some fresh air."

205.speaker: Narrator
205.text: He was wearing his usual "political uniform," grayish-green trousers and a simple tunic with a soft turn-down collar.

206.speaker: Player
206.text: "Of course. Please follow me, Chairman Malenyev."

207.speaker: Player
207.text: "Would you want to have a rest, Chairman Malenyev? We can talk later if you're not feeling well."

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: I led him up a set of back stairs to another unoccupied office with a balcony overlooking the Hill of Pride. We took our seats around a table. It was rather chilly outside.

209.speaker: Leon Malenyev
209.text: "Oh, no, I'm fine. I didn't come here to sleep. I just need some fresh air, Mr. Rayne."

210.speaker: Narrator
210.text: Reaching into his distinctive jacket, he pulled out a pipe and placed some tobacco leaves inside. The smell of the leaves was overpowering, even outside.

211.speaker: Leon Malenyev
211.text: "Chancellor Hegel told me a lot about you."

212.speaker: Narrator
212.text: After preparing his pipe, he lit it with a match. His eyes drifted away from me while the wind blew his hair and smoke to the side. He stared at the horizon to the north.

213.speaker: Leon Malenyev
213.text: "Beyond these plains lies the great Markian Sea. And in the middle of it, a small island. Small but very important."

214.speaker: Leon Malenyev
214.text: "Are you even aware what goes on there?"

215.speaker: Leon Malenyev
215.text: "Are you even aware what goes on there?"

222.speaker: Leon Malenyev
222.text: "You are supporting the foreign Agnolian regime, which is trying to destroy the local culture. The Heljilandian Valgs are being oppressed."

223.speaker: Leon Malenyev
223.text: "All of this is happening because Valgsland joined the CSP."

224.speaker: Leon Malenyev
224.text: "Your Agnolian allies installed an anti-Valgish regime in the island, which is trying its best to remove the identity of the locals. The Heljilandian Valgs are being oppressed."

225.speaker: Leon Malenyev
225.text: "I am glad that you gave your support to Chancellor Hegel."
225.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_HeljilandRecognised"] == true)

226.speaker: Leon Malenyev
226.text: "It is unacceptable to see the Valgish locals of the island being destroyed by the anti-Valgish regime in Heljiland. The oppression has become more brutal than ever before."

227.speaker: Leon Malenyev
227.text: "Valgsland needs all the support we can give to bring back peace to the island. We can't let our allies stand alone."
227.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_HeljilandRecognised"] == true) == false)

228.speaker: Leon Malenyev
228.text: "Are you aware what goes on there?"
228.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_HeljilandRecognised"] == true) == false)

229.speaker: Leon Malenyev
229.text: "Now the western powers are trying to get Agnolia to their side. They are *selling* them financial aid, weapons and intelligence, in return for pushing their political agenda."

230.speaker: Leon Malenyev
230.text: "All of this *firepower* is now being directed at the locals in Heljiland. They want to finally eliminate the Valgish culture in the island, and set up a military base close to Valgsland."

231.speaker: Leon Malenyev
231.text: "We cannot allow that to happen, can we?"

235.speaker: Player
235.text: "Heljiland is an Agnolian island, Chairman Malenyev. We cannot interfere."

240.speaker: Player
240.text: "I don't want to interfere with the matters between Valgsland and Agnolia."

244.speaker: Player
244.text: "I believe Valgsland has the right to interfere. It's their people who are being massacred."

246.speaker: Player
246.text: "You are right, Chairman Malenyev. We can't."

247.speaker: Player
247.text: "Yes. I am behind Valgsland in this conflict."

251.speaker: Leon Malenyev
251.text: "Interfere? Do you think the Agnolian government is innocent?"

252.speaker: Leon Malenyev
252.text: "Unfortunately the time to take a side has come, Mr. Rayne. You could have been right if it was just a problem between two countries."

253.speaker: Leon Malenyev
253.text: "That's right. But for me, this isn't a nationalistic problem."

254.speaker: Leon Malenyev
254.text: "Whether they are Valgs, Agnolians or Contanans who are being killed, it doesn't matter."

255.speaker: Leon Malenyev
255.text: "So you support what their government is trying to do?"

256.speaker: Leon Malenyev
256.text: "They are. Because Arcasia is funding them."

259.speaker: Leon Malenyev
259.text: "But it isn't. Not now that Arcasia has gotten involved."

260.speaker: Leon Malenyev
260.text: "What do you think they'll do next, if we let them get away with Heljiland?"

261.speaker: Leon Malenyev
261.text: "If we let them get away with what they're doing in Heljiland, they'll do a lot more."

262.speaker: Leon Malenyev
262.text: "In the end, people are dying. And for no reason other than the political aims of their governments."

263.speaker: Leon Malenyev
263.text: "Everything has become a race for total influence in Merkopa. This is just a part of Arcasia's grand plan. They want the CSP removed from the region. Agnolia is their puppet in this cause."

264.speaker: Narrator
264.text: He took a long puff on his pipe.

265.speaker: Leon Malenyev
265.text: "United Contana will never allow Arcasia to install weapons so close to Valgsland. Nor let them harass CSP ships. They can't be given control of the Markian Sea. Heljiland cannot fall."

266.speaker: Player
266.text: "I'm sure we can find a diplomatic solution with Agnolia."

267.speaker: Player
267.text: "I thought this was about people being killed."

275.speaker: Player
275.text: "You are right, Chairman Malenyev. We can't let the western powers take control."

279.speaker: Leon Malenyev
279.text: "So, you are ready to tear down the agreement..."

284.speaker: Leon Malenyev
284.text: "...And take away your support from Heljiland?"

285.speaker: Leon Malenyev
285.text: "It's not a thought, Mr. Rayne. I *know*."

287.speaker: Leon Malenyev
287.text: "I'm afraid we're past that stage by now."

289.speaker: Leon Malenyev
289.text: "It's about a group of people being destroyed to further the aims of the Agnolian government..."

290.speaker: Leon Malenyev
290.text: "...which is working towards isolating our allies, as well as expanding the influence of Arcasia."

291.speaker: Narrator
291.text: He took a another puff and started coughing heavily.

293.speaker: Player
293.text: "Yes, I am. For the good of the region."

300.speaker: Narrator
300.text: One of his bodyguards, dressed in full military uniform, rushed towards us with a bottle of water.

302.speaker: Narrator
302.text: The guard bowed in respect as Malenyev drank from the bottle. He left the balcony with quick steps.

304.speaker: Leon Malenyev
304.text: "Ah, yes. Sordland's future in the CSP."

305.speaker: Narrator
305.text: He cleaned the burnt tobacco residue from his pipe and refilled it.

306.speaker: Leon Malenyev
306.text: "You know we formed the CSP only in reaction to ATO. Their aim in the beginning was to stop us from uniting the entire continent under socialism. They failed. And now they're more scared than ever."

307.speaker: Leon Malenyev
307.text: "Today, you need the CSP in order to survive against the economic power of the west. United Contana is willing to give everything it has to help others in their fight against western dominance."

308.speaker: Leon Malenyev
308.text: "That's why they're growing more and more aggressive."

309.speaker: Player
309.text: "ATO says the same about the CSP."

310.speaker: Player
310.text: "I'm not sure if we *need* it, but I definitely want to cooperate."

311.speaker: Player
311.text: "That's why I have you here, Chairman Malenyev."

312.speaker: Narrator
312.text: He lit his pipe and took a puff. The wind pushed all of the smoke in my face.

313.speaker: Leon Malenyev
313.text: "Don't get me wrong. Sordland is a powerful country."

314.speaker: Leon Malenyev
314.text: "But the world has changed. You cannot stand alone."

316.speaker: Leon Malenyev
316.text: "Why don't you talk to President Walker then?"

317.speaker: Leon Malenyev
317.text: "ATO helps less fortunate nations with its so-called Walker Plan, doesn't it?"

318.speaker: Leon Malenyev
318.text: "Did they not include you in it? Or did you see through their plans? That they only work for the interests of Arcasian capitalism?"

319.speaker: Leon Malenyev
319.text: "Without us, Arcasia would dominate the world. The Arcasian Lira is already crippling other economies while they reap the benefits. Yet they claim they're the bringers of freedom. Absurd."

320.speaker: Leon Malenyev
320.text: "Our pact aims to develop the parts of the world that have been left out. Bring people together and make a stand. Show the world the power of the people when they unite."

321.speaker: Leon Malenyev
321.text: "...So, hereby, I extend an invitation to Sordland. I want you to see you stand with us."

322.speaker: Player
322.text: "What does the CSP offer for Sordland?"

324.speaker: Player
324.text: "Will you stand with us against the threat of Rumburg?"

326.speaker: Leon Malenyev
326.text: "Security. First and foremost, CSP is a defense pact. You will have the backing of the entire military power of our members."

327.speaker: Leon Malenyev
327.text: "United Contana and all other members are obliged to defend each other in times of war."

328.speaker: Leon Malenyev
328.text: "We also supply each nation with our military technology and assets. As well as financial aid when it's needed."

329.speaker: Leon Malenyev
329.text: "All members supply each other with their resources and goods, not for their own profit, but for the profit of the pact. Our combined production output will benefit both Sordland and the CSP."

330.speaker: Leon Malenyev
330.text: "I will also offer you a small financial contribution to help you kickstart your economy. If you sign the deal."

334.speaker: Leon Malenyev
334.text: "Not to mention visa-free access to every country within the CSP as well as other mutual assistance deals."

335.speaker: Leon Malenyev
335.text: "You must accept our doctrines and work towards the goals of the pact. To further our power against the ATO."

336.speaker: Leon Malenyev
336.text: "You will not import any technology from Arcasia, nor export natural resources to them."

337.speaker: Leon Malenyev
337.text: "Your military alliance with Lespia must be cancelled immediately."

341.speaker: Leon Malenyev
341.text: "You must also cancel your alliance with Agnolia."
341.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true)

345.speaker: Leon Malenyev
345.text: "You must also cancel your recognition of Heljiland as Agnolian territory."
345.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true)

349.speaker: Leon Malenyev
349.text: "And stop your recognition of Heljiland as Agnolian territory."

350.speaker: Leon Malenyev
350.text: "And finally, we want you to allow us to build a missile defense system in Duru island. Which will protect both Sordland and the CSP from the threat of ATO."
350.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_HeljilandRecognised"] == true) == false)

351.speaker: Narrator
351.text: He took another puff from his pipe.

352.speaker: Leon Malenyev
352.text: "Chancellor Hegel told me that I could trust you with the money."

356.speaker: Leon Malenyev
356.text: "Of course. Rumburg is a threat to Merkopa. Surely they are being pushed by the western powers to create instability in the region."

357.speaker: Leon Malenyev
357.text: "Being a CSP member, nobody will dare attack you. And if any conflict occurs nonetheless, you will have the entire CSP's support."

358.speaker: Leon Malenyev
358.text: "But my agents told me that you might be the one who wants to start a war. Not Rumburg. Is there any truth to that?"

359.speaker: Leon Malenyev
359.text: "I promise you. Their queen will no longer meddle in Sordland nor Eastern Merkopa."

375.speaker: Player
375.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Hegel_PutInAGoodWordWithMalenyev"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_FPnT_UCVisit_ListenedA"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_FPnT_UCVisit_ListenedB"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true) == false)

380.speaker: Player
380.text: "Yes. We will bring the war to them, before they are fully prepared."

381.speaker: Player
381.text: "I didn't want a war, but Rumburg pushed us to the edge."

384.speaker: Leon Malenyev
384.text: "I am not entirely sure about your decision, Mr. Rayne."

385.speaker: Leon Malenyev
385.text: "Of course, we will support you in case of a war, but all the CSP members must be included in the planning."

386.speaker: Leon Malenyev
386.text: "I'm concerned that a conflict with Rumburg, especially with our backing, may lead the entire world into a hot war."

388.speaker: Leon Malenyev
388.text: "We are talking about war, not agents. I have to first tell you something."

389.speaker: Player
389.text: "Are you saying we shouldn't attack them?"

390.speaker: Player
390.text: "Since when are you a pacifist, Chairman Malenyev?"

392.speaker: Leon Malenyev
392.text: "I'm not trying to tell you what to do, Mr. Rayne. I am just warning you."

393.speaker: Leon Malenyev
393.text: "But know that we will never allow Rumburg to destroy Eastern Merkopa. That is all I'm going to say for now."

411.speaker: Leon Malenyev
411.text: "It's good to see you stand with us, Comrade Rayne."

415.speaker: Leon Malenyev
415.text: "It's good to see you stand with us, Mr. Rayne."

417.speaker: Narrator
417.text: He narrowed his eyes and stared at me as he exhaled smoke right into my face.

418.speaker: Leon Malenyev
418.text: "Too bad, Mr. Rayne. I thought you knew what to expect when you accepted our offer to meet."

419.speaker: Leon Malenyev
419.text: "Looks like it was just a waste of time."

421.speaker: Leon Malenyev
421.text: "Nonetheless, I extend my good wishes to the Sordish people."

422.speaker: Leon Malenyev
422.text: "I wish that one day we could all set aside our differences, and all people of the world could come together. Maybe we are not ready for that today, but our revolution will keep expanding, and helping others who need it. Whether you stand with us or not."

423.speaker: Narrator
423.text: He slowly stood up from his seat, seemingly struggling.
423.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Agnolia_Alliance"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Valgsland_Alliance"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Lespia_Alliance"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false) == false

424.speaker: Leon Malenyev
424.text: "Now, I'd like to have a rest, if you'll excuse me."

425.speaker: Player
425.text: "Of course, Chairman Malenyev. Please come this way."

426.speaker: Player
426.text: "I wanted to make a deal today as well. But your terms were not acceptable."

427.speaker: Player
427.text: "We might not have come to an agreement about the CSP, but I still want to have good relations with United Contana."

428.speaker: Leon Malenyev
428.text: "Let's talk about that later, Mr. Rayne. But thank you."

429.speaker: Leon Malenyev
429.text: "It is fine, Mr. Rayne. You must have your own reasons for this decision. I cannot judge you for it."
